commit.subject: test(steme): give e2e temp units their own governing workspace
commit.body:
Migrate the audit-harness and baseline-lifecycle temp fixtures from bare
tmpdir copies to self-governing units: each app copy now sits at
<workspace>/app under a seeded steme.workspace.json whose policy is the
real @steme-lab/rulepack-boundaries package copied into the workspace's
node_modules. Inert by construction — discovery still walks up from cwd,
so the repo workspace keeps governing and every suite passes unmodified.
Prepares the discovery-origin flip.

phases.title: Self-governing e2e fixtures, inert under cwd-discovery

commit.subject: feat(steme): discover the governing workspace from the audit target
commit.body:
The governing workspace — policy source and reporting anchor — is now
found by walking up from the audited target instead of the invocation's
cwd: a unit is judged by the workspace it belongs to, from any working
directory, and its diagnostic paths render relative to that workspace. A
target with no steme.workspace.json at or above it is refused in
preflight (exit 2) instead of silently borrowing the cwd's policy.
Fingerprints, registers, and drift are byte-identical; proven red-first
via relative-path and cwd-independence e2e assertions, the refusal
fixture, and the unmodified policy/self-audit/baseline suites.

phases.title: Discover the workspace from the target; refuse workspace-less targets
